standing: these are authorization records and their admission rules. NOTHING was executed: no test ran, no preparation ran, no repair was applied.

records.authorizationClass: explicit consent, and in CI a policy record
records.receipt: a test import is admitted; the step mints no run3

records.authorizationClass: per-owner native preparation authorization (workflows section 12 delegating to native section 14 and security S15)
records.d9: request-rejected 2 for authorization, operational-failed 4 for a fault
records.receipt: an execution receipt plus ONE admitted prepared import, never a Run
records.retryPolicy: none by schema -- there is no automatic retry

records.authorizationClass: a security authorization bound to the EXACT repairPlanId and baseSnapshotId
records.receipt: a MutationReceiptV1 keyed by the content-derived repair-apply key; VERIFY afterwards admits a FRESH snapshot and seals a NEW Run

threeSeparatelyAuthorizedSteps: preview, apply and verify are three separately authorized steps: a preview authorization is not an apply authorization, and an apply authorization does not authorize the verify analysis that follows it.
